lock_statement: These perturbation bounds were fixed and committed BEFORE any experiment output existed (no outputs/ directory at lock time). The outputs manifest records the sha256 of this file; check_inputs.py fails if this file changes after outputs were generated.
source_of_ranges: inputs/uncertainty_assumptions.json (check_inputs.py enforces that every value here equals the corresponding bound there)
perturbation_model: multiplicative symmetric: perturbed = nominal * factor, factor = 1 + U(-b, +b) where b is the bound as a fraction; exact zero nominal values stay exactly zero; all seven macro fields scale independently per draw unless the arm is portion-only

plausible.description: Plausible nutrient-uncertainty envelope (typical error). NOT adversarial.

stress.description: STRESS / ADVERSARIAL envelope - upper-envelope judgment anchored to cited tails. NEVER report these as plausible daily error; arms are labeled stress in all outputs.

arms.description: each macro field independently perturbed, plausible bounds
single common per-serving scale factor, plausible bound
each macro field independently perturbed, STRESS bounds
single common per-serving scale factor, STRESS bound

never_perturbed: ranking weights and constants (72.0, 2.5, 6.5, 8.0, time +6.0/+3.0, goal +5.0/-3.0/+3.0, high-protein +4.0, missing-required 24.0, bonus +10.0, rating divisor 20.0)
